changelog:
Typography options now take effect on the screen you are looking at: changing the font, font scale, letter spacing or line height applies immediately instead of only after leaving and reopening the page.
Text that CloudStream composes after that pass — a new row, a new section, a list that just scrolled in — receives the configured typography again as well.
Changing the font scale back down scales the text back exactly, and changing it up again does not compound the previous scaling.
message: Dev build v869 - typography settings apply live and to newly composed text
